user.title: eBUS Heating Control
user.description: Connect to ebusd. Requires the TCP command port (write) and the HTTP-JSON port (read) to be exposed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ebusd. Are ports 8888 (TCP) and 8889 (HTTP) exposed?

abort.already_configured: This ebusd instance is already configured.

data.fast: Read directly from the bus (substrings, comma-separated) – these stay as fresh as the poll interval. Use sparingly!
data.boiler_room_sensor: Boiler regulation: room temperature sensor (leave empty to disable)
data.boiler_outdoor_sensor: Boiler regulation: outdoor temperature sensor (optional, enables the heating curve)
data.boiler_curve_slope: Boiler regulation: heating curve slope (only used if an outdoor sensor is set)
data.boiler_base_flow: Boiler regulation: base flow temperature used when no outdoor sensor is set (°C)
data.boiler_hysteresis: Boiler regulation: heat-demand hysteresis (°C, stop overshoot above target)
